description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
